blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.store.order` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Store API routes.

This method retrieves a paginated list of orders matching the specified filters. It
sends a request to the [List Orders](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#orders\_getorders)
API route.
